Description
Experience luxury redefined in this stunning 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom home on the 24th floor of The Butterfly—an architectural icon by Revery Architecture, with breathtaking ocean and city views. The home features a sleek, modern interior with top-of-the-line finishes, including a high-end kitchen equipped with Miele appliances, custom cabinetry, and quartz countertops. Residents of The Butterfly enjoy access to an exceptional range of amenities, including a 24-hour concierge, swimming pool, fully equipped fitness centre and wellness centre with hydrotherapy.
